doc.pickTopic: Pick a topic to see its document
doc.pausedHintEditable: This document uses syntax the editor doesn't fully support, so autosave is paused. Switch to source mode to save your edits.
doc.pausedHintReadOnly: Nothing is autosaved in read-only mode. Switch back to edit mode to save these changes.
doc.pendingEditsNotice: Some unsaved edits couldn't be carried into the current editor, which shows the version on disk. The edits are still held, and you can take them back at any time.
doc.pendingEditsCount: There are {count} sets; the most recent one comes back first.
doc.externalConflict: Cheese updated this document on disk while you had unsaved edits. Both versions are still here — pick one to continue.
doc.lossyBannerBlocked: This document uses syntax the editor doesn't fully support, so editing it needs source mode, which isn't available on a phone. Open it on a computer to edit.
doc.lossyBanner: This document uses syntax the editor doesn't fully support, so a visual edit may drop formatting when it saves. Autosave is paused; use source mode to edit.
doc.confirmOverwriteBody: This document uses syntax the visual editor doesn't fully support. Saving it directly rewrites the file the way the editor read it, and anything unsupported is lost.
doc.confirmOverwriteHint: Editing in source mode keeps the original text intact. Your current edits are set aside, and you can take them back with one click after switching.
doc.conflictReloadFailed: The document was changed elsewhere, so this save was not written

preview.fullscreenFailed: Couldn't go fullscreen. Try opening it in a new tab.

preview.specifiedFileUnreadable: The named file can't be read

preview.appOfflineTunnelUp: That machine is still connected, but nothing is answering on the registered port. The service Cheese started has most likely exited — mention {'@'} it once more to start it again.
preview.appOfflineNoTunnel: The machine running this topic isn't carrying a preview tunnel right now (it's offline, or this turn hasn't started). Mention {'@'} Cheese once more to start it again.
preview.staleDoc: This is the previously generated version; the refresh didn't finish: {reason}
preview.notTextDetail: {path} can't be shown as a web page — open it in a new window

preview.urlUnavailable: The preview address isn't available yet
